title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding

numbers.sentence: We choose the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset , which consists of approximately 4.5 million sentence pairs.
The result uses beam search with a beam size of 4 and length penalty 0.6.
Label smoothing with 0.1 is also adopted.
We use the BookCorpus and the Wikipedia Corpus from Huggingface Datasets library (Apache License 2.0) for pre-training.

We use Huggingface Transformers library (Apache License 2.0) to fine-tune each of the aforementioned downstream tasks for 3 epochs, with a maximum sequence length of 512, batch size of 32 and learning rates 2,3,4,5e-5.
However, when increasing the maximum input text length to 1024, RoFormer outperforms WoBERT by an absolute improvement of 1.5%.

We use Huggingface Transformers library (Apache License 2.0) to fine-tune each of the aforementioned downstream tasks for 3 epochs, with a maximum sequence length of 512, batch size of 32 and learning rates 2,3,4,5e-5.
We incorporate RoPE into the 12 layer char-based PerFormer with 768 dimensions and 12 heads .
We incorporate RoPE into the 12 layer char-based PerFormer with 768 dimensions and 12 heads .
We pre-train RoFormer on approximately 34GB of data collected from Chinese Wikipedia, news and forums.
